meta.name: wowerpoint
meta.description: Turn one document into a kawaii NotebookLM slide-deck PDF. Use for "wowerpoint this", "make a deck about <file>", "turn this report into slides", or any request to render a single document as shareable narrative slides.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把文档一键变成可爱风演示文稿 PDF
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常要把报告或文档快速变成可分享的演示文稿
copy.tagline_en: Turn a document into a cute presentation PDF
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often turn reports or documents into shareable presentations

howto.what: 装上后，让它把单个文档变成幻灯片时，它会调用 NotebookLM 生成可爱风格的 PDF 幻灯片，先给出可观看生成的笔记本地址；若所需环境变量已配置，还会返回一个手机版分享链接。
howto.when: 当用户说出“Wowerpoint this”“make a deck about <文件>”“把这份报告做成幻灯片”等指令，或提出把单个文档渲染成可分享的叙述型幻灯片时触发。

say.note: 会生成 PDF 幻灯片并给出笔记本实时地址。

say.text: 把这篇技术方案做成幻灯片
say.note: 如果原文太单薄，会先补写再开始生成。

say.text: Make a deck about 我上传的用户研究报告
say.note: 默认会使用可爱风格的提示词来讲述内容。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude can turn one document into a kawaii-style slide-deck PDF via NotebookLM, print a notebook URL for live viewing, and return a mobile-friendly share link if the required environment variables are set.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user says "Wowerpoint this", "make a deck about <file>", "turn this report into slides", or asks to render a single document as shareable narrative slides.

say_en.note: Creates a PDF deck and prints the live notebook URL.

say_en.text: Turn this design proposal into slides
say_en.note: Expands the source first if it is too thin.

say_en.text: Make a deck about the uploaded user study
say_en.note: Uses the default kawaii storytelling prompt.
